  }

  Group build() const {
    Group value;
    value.middles_ = middles_;
    return value;
  }

private:
  static bool validate_middles(const std::vector<::Middle>& value) {
    if (value.size() > 2) {
      return false;
    }
    for (const auto& element_0 : value) {
    }
    return true;
  }

  std::optional<std::vector<::Middle>> middles_;
};

::quarry::runtime::EncodeResult<std::vector<std::byte>> encode_result(const Group& value) {
  std::vector<::quarry::runtime::FieldBytes> fields;
  fields.reserve(1U);
  if (value.has_middles()) {
    if (value.middles()->size() > 2U) {
      return ::quarry::runtime::encode_failure<std::vector<std::byte>>(::quarry::runtime::EncodeError::bounds_exceeded, {{.field_index = 0U, .array_index = std::nullopt}});
    }
    std::vector<std::byte> field_bytes;
    ::quarry::runtime::append_varuint(field_bytes, value.middles()->size());
    for (std::size_t element_index = 0U; element_index < value.middles()->size(); ++element_index) {
      const auto& element = (*value.middles())[element_index];
      auto element_bytes = ::encode_result(element);
      if (!element_bytes.has_value()) {
        auto nested_path = std::move(element_bytes.path);
        nested_path.push_back(::quarry::runtime::PathElement{
          .field_index = 0U,
          .array_index = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(element_index),
        });
        return ::quarry::runtime::encode_failure<std::vector<std::byte>>(element_bytes.error, std::move(nested_path));
      }
      ::quarry::runtime::append_varuint(field_bytes, element_bytes.value->size());
      ::quarry::runtime::append_bytes(field_bytes, std::span<const std::byte>(element_bytes.value->data(), element_bytes.value->size()));
    }
    fields.push_back(::quarry::runtime::FieldBytes{
      .field_index = 0U,
      .bytes = std::move(field_bytes),
    });
  }
  return ::quarry::runtime::encode_brf_v2_record_result(brf_v2_layout_Group(), fields);
}


std::optional<std::vector<std::byte>> encode(const Group& value) {
  auto encoded = encode_result(value);
  if (!encoded.value.has_value()) {
    return std::nullopt;
  }
  return std::move(encoded.value);
}


::quarry::runtime::DecodeResult<Group> decode_Group_result(std::span<const std::byte> input) {
  const auto parsed = ::quarry::runtime::parse_brf_v2_record(input, brf_v2_layout_Group());
  if (!parsed.record.has_value()) {
    return ::quarry::runtime::decode_failure<Group>(::quarry::runtime::brf_v2_decode_error(parsed.error), {}, parsed.offset);
  }
  if (parsed.record->record_id != 4U) {
    return ::quarry::runtime::decode_failure<Group>(::quarry::runtime::DecodeError::unexpected_record_id, {}, 0U);
  }
  GroupBuilder builder;
  if (const auto* field = ::quarry::runtime::find_field(*parsed.record, 0U); field != nullptr) {
    std::size_t element_offset = 0U;
    const auto decoded_count = ::quarry::runtime::read_varuint(field->bytes, element_offset);
    if (!decoded_count.value.has_value() || *decoded_count.value > 2U) {
      if (!decoded_count.value.has_value()) {
        return ::quarry::runtime::decode_failure<Group>(decoded_count.error, {{.field_index = 0U, .array_index = std::nullopt}}, field->field_offset);
      }
      return ::quarry::runtime::decode_failure<Group>(::quarry::runtime::DecodeError::bounds_exceeded, {{.field_index = 0U, .array_index = std::nullopt}}, field->field_offset);
    }
    const auto element_count = static_cast<std::size_t>(*decoded_count.value);
    std::vector<::Middle> elements;
    elements.reserve(element_count);
    for (std::size_t index = 0U; index < element_count; ++index) {
      const std::size_t element_length_start = element_offset;
      const auto decoded_length = ::quarry::runtime::read_varuint(field->bytes, element_offset);
      if (!decoded_length.value.has_value()) {
        return ::quarry::runtime::decode_failure<Group>(decoded_length.error, {{.field_index = 0U, .array_index = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(index)}}, field->field_offset + element_length_start);
      }
      if (*decoded_length.value > field->bytes.size() - element_offset) {
        return ::quarry::runtime::decode_failure<Group>(::quarry::runtime::DecodeError::invalid_field_length, {{.field_index = 0U, .array_index = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(index)}}, field->field_offset + element_offset);
      }
      const auto element_length = static_cast<std::size_t>(*decoded_length.value);
      const auto element_bytes = field->bytes.subspan(element_offset, element_length);
      auto decoded = ::decode_Middle_result(element_bytes);
      if (!decoded.value.has_value()) {
        auto nested_path = std::move(decoded.path);
        nested_path.push_back(::quarry::runtime::PathElement{
          .field_index = 0U,
          .array_index = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(index),
        });
        const std::optional<std::uint64_t> nested_offset = decoded.byte_offset.has_value()
          ? std::optional<std::uint64_t>(field->field_offset + element_offset + *decoded.byte_offset)
          : std::nullopt;
        return ::quarry::runtime::decode_failure<Group>(decoded.error, std::move(nested_path), nested_offset);
      }
      elements.push_back(*decoded.value);
      element_offset += element_length;
    }
    if (element_offset != field->bytes.size()) {
      return ::quarry::runtime::decode_failure<Group>(::quarry::runtime::DecodeError::invalid_field_length, {{.field_index = 0U, .array_index = std::nullopt}}, field->field_offset + element_offset);
    }
    if (!builder.set_middles(std::move(elements))) {
      return ::quarry::runtime::decode_failure<Group>(::quarry::runtime::DecodeError::bounds_exceeded, {{.field_index = 0U, .array_index = std::nullopt}}, field->field_offset);
    }
  }
  return ::quarry::runtime::decoded_value<Group>(builder.build());
}


std::optional<Group> decode_Group(std::span<const std::byte> input) {
  auto decoded = decode_Group_result(input);
  if (!decoded.value.has_value()) {
    return std::nullopt;
  }
  return std::move(decoded.value);
}
